ns2:section.sectionText: This section is a self-paced orientation course to the NRES MS program. The instructor will contact enrolled students via email or phone and provide them with course access instructions. This course section is open to any NRES MS online degree-seeking student. This is not a joint offering with any other program. Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $362 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. These per credit hour assessments are not included in campus range assessments.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
